change.implementation: scripts/backup.mjs requires every present asset nodeId and jobId to resolve to producer records in the same project and session, and requires a referenced job to identify the same node when nodeId is present
change.boundary: backup creation and restore reject dangling or cross-scope asset producer provenance before atomic promotion
change.negativeFixture: a synthetic reference asset whose nodeId points to a nonexistent database entity

limitations: This increment validates asset producer provenance but does not yet validate every relationship among all database entity kinds.
Independent review, off-host retention, staging drills and production rollback remain separately gated.
